# Interactive CLI contract (add, init) - decided 2026-11-23, owner-approved direction

When prompts run
- stdin AND stderr are terminals and output is text: prompts.
- --format json, or stdin or stderr not a terminal: never prompt. add without flags -> E214; init without --yes -> E240; each names the flags to pass.
- Blank or whitespace --summary: error before any prompt.

Ending a run
- Completed: path written; next-step line on stderr; exit 0.
- Esc or Ctrl-C at any prompt: "Cancelled, nothing written."; exit 130.
- Declining the review / write confirmation: "Cancelled, nothing written."; exit 0.
- Editor saves nothing or exits non-zero: "Cancelled, nothing written."; exit 0.
- External kill -INT at a prompt: default signal behaviour (signal 2), nothing written; documented limit: terminal may need `reset`.
- SIGINT while $EDITOR runs (unix): ignored by Callisto (git launch_editor precedent); the editor decides. No signal thread anywhere.

Editor and inputs
- $VISUAL else $EDITOR; blank = unset; none -> inline summary prompt.
- Unusable editor (split error, not found, non-UTF-8): one warning naming the variable and command, then the inline prompt, answers kept.
- Whitespace-only inline summary: re-prompt.
- Changed packages first and ticked, exactly as status reports; detection failure -> one warning, all unticked.
- JSON mode: exactly one report on stdout; notes once on stderr.

init and origin
- Missing or non-hosted origin: one note; preview and init continue unbound; the remote value is never printed.
- --workflow / --artifact-target without a hosted origin: E299, help names git remote get-url --push origin / set-url --push.

Exit codes: 0 success or decline; 1 error; 2 usage; 130 cancelled at a prompt.

Proposed additions (2026-11-24, pending owner approval)
- TERM=dumb never prompts (E214/E240), as non-TTY.
- While init prompts, its facts and preview go to stderr so the user sees what they confirm.
- Ticking no packages in add re-asks instead of E273.
Accepted limits (documented, not built): resize mid-prompt redraws on the next key; the editor temp file can leak if the terminal is closed while the editor is open.

Rendering (decided 2026-11-24)
- Callisto does no terminal sizing and never rewrites labels: full package names are shown and filtered; inquire's default page size; inquire wraps long labels.
- Documented limits of the prompt library: resizing mid-prompt or a pane under about 10 rows can misdraw; use a bigger pane or pass --package/--summary.

//! The one contract for interactive prompts: where they may run, how they end, and how `$EDITOR` is used.

use std::io::IsTerminal as _;

use unicode_width::{UnicodeWidthChar, UnicodeWidthStr};

use crate::cli::OutputFormat;
use crate::error::CliError;

/// Proof that this run may prompt; only [`Prompts::detect`] makes one.
pub struct Prompts(());

impl Prompts {
    /// Prompts need a person at the terminal (stdin, and stderr where they draw) and a text run: `--format json` is for
    /// scripts and never prompts.
    pub fn detect(format: OutputFormat) -> Option<Self> {
        (format == OutputFormat::Text && std::io::stdin().is_terminal() && std::io::stderr().is_terminal())
            .then_some(Self(()))
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub fn for_tests() -> Self {
        Self(())
    }
}

/// The two list prompts: what each draws beside its options.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum ListKind {
    /// Pick one: `> ` before each option.
    Select,
    /// Tick any: `> [x] ` before each option.
    MultiSelect,
}

impl ListKind {
    /// Columns drawn before each option's label.
    const fn prefix(self) -> usize {
        match self {
            Self::Select => 2,
            Self::MultiSelect => 6,
        }
    }

    /// The keys, in ASCII so a terminal that cannot draw arrows still reads it.
    pub const fn help(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Select => "Up/Down move, Enter selects, type to filter",
            Self::MultiSelect => "Up/Down move, Space toggles, Right all, Left none, type to filter",
        }
    }
}

pub struct ListLayout {
    pub page_size: usize,
    /// One terminal row each; the same order and count as the labels given.

content.text:
I've committed the rendering fix locally as a signed commit, `0166e505b`, in `.claude/worktrees/wp-add-inquire` (branch `wp-add-inquire`, on top of `8944d2aa7`). Every gate passed. Nothing is pushed and no findings were touched.

**What changed** (9 files, 77 lines added, 240 removed):
- **`tty.rs`:** deleted the page-size helper, the label truncation and their 6 unit tests.
- **`add.rs` and `init.rs`:** they now pass full names to inquire for both display and filtering, with inquire's default page size. I kept the ASCII help text.
- **`Cargo.toml`:** dropped the `crossterm` and `unicode-width` dependencies, which nothing else used. `Cargo.lock` only loses those two lines.
- **Tests:** removed the short-terminal test, which only covered the sizing. I added a pty test in `add_interactive_pty_tests.rs`: two packages whose names differ only in their last word, on a 40-column terminal. It checks both names appear in full, and that typing `right` then Space ticks the right package. It failed before the change (E273, the filter matched nothing) and passes now.
- **`docs/specs/cli.json`:** CLI-ADD-03 and CLI-INIT-02 now state the rendering rule and the limits (resizing mid-question or a pane under about 10 rows can misdraw; use a bigger pane or pass `--package`/`--summary`). The changeset has a matching bullet.

This should resolve both open findings on trail #487: one is the truncation, the other the resize issue, which is now a documented limit.

**Audit passes** (diff against `origin/main`, checked against every row of the contract, the finding history and the review checklist):
1. `tty::prompt` only repeated what the existing `From<InquireError>` conversion already does, so I removed it and the call sites use `?` directly.
2. The exit-code constant `CANCELLED_BY_CTRL_C` also covers Esc, so I renamed it `CANCELLED_EXIT` and corrected its comment.
3. Nothing new found.

**Gate:** `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test` (run outside the sandbox for the pty tests) and `just audit` all exited 0. `just pre-push` first failed on rustfmt in the new test; I ran `cargo fmt` and it passed. No public signature in `callisto-model` or `callisto-manifests` changed, so `just fuzz-check` doesn't apply.

**For the lead:**
- E299's help on this branch still says `git remote add origin <url>`, not the `get-url --push` / `set-url --push` wording the contract asks for. That is open finding #1 in the history and belongs to the onboarding work, not this PR, so I left it.
- Open finding #2 (the init origin note) depends on the pending "init shows its facts and preview on stderr" proposal, so I left it too.
